description: Reject the proposed backlog of an initiative (HIL #1) and send it back to the Architect with `feedback` as its instructions: the counterpart of anyforge_approve_backlog, by the same path as a REJECTED decision on the plan-approval gate. The initiative is not approved; the Architect proposes a new plan. Empty feedback is refused with 400 `notes_required`; an initiative with no plan awaiting approval with `no_pending_plan`; a key holder who cannot decide plans with 403 `forbidden_role`. Requires `approve` scope.

feedback.description: What the Architect should change in the plan. Required.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_reject_backlog
title: Reject backlog
